First create the stratified sampling design, where each department is a stratum

```{r}
library(survey)
faculty = read.csv("faculty.csv", header = T)

facultydes = svydesign(id = ~1, strata = ~dept, weights = ~w, fpc = ~N_h, data = faculty)
```

**Question 1:**

```{r}
women_frac = svymean(~sex, facultydes)
women_frac
confint(women_frac, level = .95)
```

**Question 2:**

```{r}
has_grant_frac = svymean(~grant_2026, facultydes)
has_grant_frac
confint(has_grant_frac)
```

**Question 3:**

```{r}
phddes = subset(facultydes, has_phd == 1)
avg_years_phd = svymean(~years_since_phd, phddes, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_years_phd
confint(avg_years_phd, level = .95)
```

**Question 4:**

```{r}
phd_duke_frac = svymean(~phd_duke, phddes, nam.rm = TRUE)
phd_duke_frac
confint(phd_duke_frac, level = 0.95)
```
